about: Monthly costs outside AWS, entered by hand: subscriptions and seats that no API reports. An item with amount_usd null is known but not priced; the exporter counts it as unpriced and leaves it off the bill until a price is entered. Amounts are what the invoice says, in USD; an invoice in another currency is converted by hand and the rate noted in 'about'.

items.about: Covers the Claude Code API calls, which the bill shows at their list-price equivalent.
Organisation seats and Actions minutes beyond the free tier, if any.
